title: 光學玻璃精密退火~Precision annealing of optical glass
focus: 玻璃轉變區的應力鬆弛、冷卻速率對折射率的影響、殘餘應力雙折射與均勻性驗收~Stress relaxation in the glass-transition range, cooling-rate dependence of refractive index, residual stress birefringence and homogeneity acceptance
summary: 以一塊厚 100 mm 的 N-BK7 光學玻璃毛胚為案例：從黏度與 Maxwell 鬆弛時間說明退火點與應變點的意義，推導冷卻速率如何透過假想溫度改變折射率、毛胚內溫差如何依 Adams–Williamson 關係凍結成殘餘應力，再談精密退火爐的均勻性要求、應力雙折射與折射率均勻性的量測，最後設計一份完整的退火程式並以熔次資料表完成與光學設計的交接。~Using a 100 mm thick N-BK7 blank as the case, the course explains the annealing and strain points through viscosity and the Maxwell relaxation time, derives how cooling rate changes refractive index via the fictive temperature and how the temperature difference inside the blank freezes into residual stress by the Adams–Williamson relation, then covers the uniformity demands on a precision annealing furnace, the measurement of stress birefringence and index homogeneity, and finally designs a complete annealing schedule and hands the melt data sheet over to optical design.

units.anchor: 黏度溫度曲線與退火點~Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point
units.title: 玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間~Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time
units.mechanism: 玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。應力以 Maxwell 模型鬆弛，時間常數 τ = η/G，所以在退火點附近幾十秒就能釋放應力，在應變點以下則需要數小時到數天，實際上被凍結。N-BK7 的轉變溫度約 557 °C，精密退火就是在這段溫度範圍內用受控的速率冷卻。~Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower. Stress relaxes by the Maxwell model with a time constant τ = η/G, so near the annealing point stress releases within tens of seconds, while below the strain point it would take hours to days and is effectively frozen. N-BK7 has a transformation temperature near 557 °C, and precision annealing means cooling through this range at a controlled rate.
units.model: N-BK7 的剪切模數 G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa。退火點 η = 10¹² Pa·s 時 τ = 10¹²/3.4×10¹⁰ ≈ 29 s；應變點 η = 3.2×10¹³ Pa·s 時 τ ≈ 930 s ≈ 15 min；再低約 100 K 處 η ≈ 10¹⁶ Pa·s，τ ≈ 2.9×10⁵ s ≈ 3.4 天，應力已無法在製程時間內鬆弛。~The shear modulus of N-BK7 is G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa. At the annealing point, η = 10¹² Pa·s, τ = 10¹²/3.4×10¹⁰ ≈ 29 s; at the strain point, η = 3.2×10¹³ Pa·s, τ ≈ 930 s ≈ 15 min; about 100 K lower, η ≈ 10¹⁶ Pa·s and τ ≈ 2.9×10⁵ s ≈ 3.4 days, so stress can no longer relax within process time.
units.verify: 取同一熔次的小試片，在幾個溫度下施加固定彎曲應變並以偏光儀即時觀察應力雙折射的衰減，擬合指數時間常數並與 η/G 預測比較；由此校正該玻璃的退火點與應變點，而不是只依型錄值。~Take small coupons from the same melt, apply a fixed bending strain at several temperatures and watch the stress birefringence decay in real time with a polarimeter, fit the exponential time constant and compare with the η/G prediction; use this to calibrate the annealing and strain points of that glass instead of relying only on catalogue values.
units.failure: 若把應變點以下的溫度當成仍可鬆弛的區間，程式在那裡放慢冷卻完全無效，而真正需要慢冷的退火點附近卻冷得太快，毛胚帶著殘餘應力出爐，拋光後面形隨材料去除而變化。~Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast; the blank leaves the furnace with residual stress and its figure changes as material is removed in polishing.
units.misconception: 玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。~Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature.

units.anchor: 假想溫度與折射率~Fictive temperature and refractive index
units.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率~How cooling rate sets the refractive index
units.mechanism: 穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。每把冷卻速率提高十倍，T_f 大約上升二十幾度，因此折射率與冷卻速率的對數成線性關係，玻璃廠以退火係數描述：n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀)。型錄折射率對應參考冷卻速率，任何後續的熱成形或模造若用不同速率冷卻，折射率就會偏離，必須重新退火或在設計中用實測值。~On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f; faster cooling freezes the structure at a higher temperature with lower density and hence lower refractive index. Each tenfold increase in cooling rate raises T_f by roughly twenty-odd kelvin, so refractive index is linear in the logarithm of cooling rate, which glass makers express with an annealing coefficient: n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀). Catalogue indices correspond to a reference cooling rate, and any later hot forming or molding cooled at a different rate shifts the index, requiring re-annealing or the use of measured values in design.
units.model: 以 T_g ≈ 830 K、活化能 E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol 估計，每十倍速率的 T_f 變化 ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K。取教學值 m ≈ −1×10⁻³（每十倍）：冷卻速率比參考值快 10 倍時 n_d 低 0.001，慢 10 倍則高 0.001；dn/dT_f ≈ −0.001/26 ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹。要把折射率控制在 ±0.0002，速率必須落在參考值的 10^±0.2 即 0.63 到 1.6 倍之間。~Estimating with T_g ≈ 830 K and activation energy E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol, the change of T_f per decade of rate is ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K. With a teaching value m ≈ −1×10⁻³ per decade, cooling 10 times faster than the reference rate lowers n_d by 0.001 and 10 times slower raises it by 0.001; dn/dT_f ≈ −0.001/26 ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹. Holding the index to ±0.0002 requires the rate to stay within 10^±0.2, i.e. 0.63 to 1.6 times the reference rate.
units.verify: 把同一熔次的試片分別以 0.5、5 與 50 K/h 冷卻，用 V 形塊折射儀或最小偏向角法量 n_d 到 10⁻⁵，將 n_d 對 log₁₀(h) 作圖，斜率就是該玻璃的實際退火係數，與玻璃廠公布值比較。~Cool coupons from the same melt at 0.5, 5 and 50 K/h, measure n_d to 10⁻⁵ with a V-block refractometer or the minimum-deviation method, plot n_d against log₁₀(h), and take the slope as the actual annealing coefficient of that glass for comparison with the maker's published value.
units.failure: 模造鏡片以每分鐘數十度冷卻，折射率比型錄低約 0.002，若設計時沿用型錄值，焦距偏移超過景深，整批模造鏡片的 MTF 不達標，而面形量測卻完全合格。~A molded lens cooled at tens of kelvin per minute has an index about 0.002 below catalogue; a design that keeps the catalogue value shifts focus beyond the depth of focus and the whole molded batch misses MTF, although its figure measurements pass completely.
units.misconception: 折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。~Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history.

units.anchor: 精密退火爐與溫度均勻性~Precision annealing furnace and temperature uniformity
units.title: 退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載~Annealing-furnace design: uniformity, thermocouples and loading
units.mechanism: 精密退火爐是一個以多區加熱、厚重爐膛與輻射屏蔽把毛胚包起來的慢速溫控系統，目標不是加熱而是讓整個裝載區在冷卻過程中保持極小的空間溫差：橫向溫差會在凍結瞬間變成假想溫度差，直接轉成折射率的不均勻。熱電偶要靠近毛胚、定期以固定點或參考熱電偶校正，控制器以程式化的速率曲線運行數天到數週；毛胚放在耐火板與分離粉上，避免黏結與因接觸造成的局部熱流。~A precision annealing furnace is a slow temperature-control system with multi-zone heating, a massive muffle and radiation shields enclosing the blanks; its purpose is not heating but keeping the spatial temperature difference across the load extremely small during cooling, because a lateral difference at the moment of freezing becomes a fictive-temperature difference and hence index inhomogeneity. Thermocouples sit close to the blanks and are calibrated regularly against fixed points or reference thermocouples, the controller runs a programmed rate curve over days to weeks, and blanks rest on refractory plates with parting powder to avoid sticking and local heat flow through contact.
units.model: 以 dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ 計，裝載區在凍結時若有 1 K 的橫向溫差，毛胚內折射率差達 3.8×10⁻⁵，遠超 H2 級的 ±5×10⁻⁶；要達 H3 級的 ±2×10⁻⁶，溫差須小於約 0.05 K。黏度在退火點附近每 25 K 變化約一個數量級，所以熱電偶 5 K 的絕對誤差會讓鬆弛時間差 10^(5/25) ≈ 1.6 倍，保溫時間必須留此餘裕。~With dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹, a lateral difference of 1 K across the load at freezing produces an index difference of 3.8×10⁻⁵ inside the blank, far beyond the ±5×10⁻⁶ of grade H2; reaching grade H3 at ±2×10⁻⁶ needs a difference below about 0.05 K. Viscosity changes by about one order of magnitude per 25 K near the annealing point, so a 5 K absolute thermocouple error changes relaxation time by 10^(5/25) ≈ 1.6 times, and the hold time must carry that margin.
units.verify: 在空爐與滿載時於裝載區放置多支校正過的熱電偶，記錄整個冷卻程式中各點溫度，計算最大橫向與縱向溫差隨時間的曲線；再把退火後毛胚的折射率均勻性圖與溫差分佈比對，確認兩者的空間圖樣相關。~Place several calibrated thermocouples across the load zone with the furnace empty and fully loaded, log every point through the whole cooling programme and compute the maximum lateral and vertical differences versus time; then compare the index-homogeneity map of the annealed blank with the temperature-difference distribution to confirm that the spatial patterns correlate.
units.failure: 爐門一側的隔熱老化後形成 0.5 K 的穩定梯度，整批毛胚的折射率沿同一方向出現 2×10⁻⁵ 的線性變化，對大口徑透鏡等效於一個無法用修形去除的楔形相位。~Degraded insulation on one side of the furnace door creates a stable 0.5 K gradient, every blank in the batch shows a 2×10⁻⁵ linear index variation in the same direction, and for a large lens this is a wedge-like phase error that figuring cannot remove.
units.misconception: 退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。~An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one.

units.anchor: 毛胚厚度與熱擴散率~Blank thickness and thermal diffusivity
units.title: 毛胚內溫差、凍結應力與 Adams–Williamson 關係~Internal temperature difference, frozen stress and the Adams–Williamson relation
units.mechanism: 以固定速率冷卻的玻璃板，中心比表面熱，溫差與速率成正比、與厚度平方成正比、與熱擴散率成反比。穿過轉變區時這個溫差被凍結：之後中心比表面多收縮，於是表面受壓、中心受拉，形成永久的殘餘應力；Adams 與 Williamson 在 1920 年給出永久應力與冷卻速率的正比關係，是退火程式設計的核心。厚毛胚因此需要極慢的冷卻，退火時間以週計。~A glass plate cooled at a constant rate is hotter at its centre than at its surface, with a difference proportional to rate and to thickness squared and inversely proportional to thermal diffusivity. On passing through the transition range this difference is frozen: the centre then contracts more than the surface, leaving the surface in compression and the centre in tension as permanent residual stress; Adams and Williamson in 1920 gave the proportionality between permanent stress and cooling rate that underlies every annealing schedule. Thick blanks therefore need very slow cooling, with annealing times measured in weeks.
units.model: 中心與表面溫差 ΔT = q·d²/(8a)：N-BK7 熱擴散率 a = k/(ρc_p) = 1.114/(2510×858) ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s；厚度 d = 100 mm、速率 q = 1 K/h = 2.78×10⁻⁴ K/s 時 ΔT ≈ 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(8×5.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 0.67 K。表面永久應力 σ ≈ (2/3)·Eα/(1−ν)·ΔT，Eα/(1−ν) = 82×10⁹×7.1×10⁻⁶/0.794 ≈ 0.73 MPa/K，得 σ ≈ 0.33 MPa；速率降為 0.3 K/h 時 ΔT ≈ 0.20 K、σ ≈ 0.10 MPa。~The centre-to-surface difference is ΔT = q·d²/(8a): N-BK7 has diffusivity a = k/(ρc_p) = 1.114/(2510×858) ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s; with thickness d = 100 mm and rate q = 1 K/h = 2.78×10⁻⁴ K/s, ΔT ≈ 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(8×5.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 0.67 K. The permanent surface stress is σ ≈ (2/3)·Eα/(1−ν)·ΔT with Eα/(1−ν) = 82×10⁹×7.1×10⁻⁶/0.794 ≈ 0.73 MPa/K, giving σ ≈ 0.33 MPa; at 0.3 K/h, ΔT ≈ 0.20 K and σ ≈ 0.10 MPa.
units.verify: 在一塊犧牲毛胚中心鑽孔埋入熱電偶，與表面熱電偶同步記錄冷卻過程，實測 ΔT 並與 q·d²/(8a) 比較以校正熱擴散率；退火後以偏光儀量中心與邊緣的應力雙折射，核對應力分佈是否呈拋物線且大小接近 Adams–Williamson 估計。~Embed a thermocouple in a hole drilled to the centre of a sacrificial blank, log it together with a surface thermocouple during cooling, and compare the measured ΔT with q·d²/(8a) to calibrate the diffusivity; after annealing, measure the stress birefringence at centre and edge with a polarimeter and check that the distribution is parabolic with a magnitude close to the Adams–Williamson estimate.
units.failure: 把 50 mm 毛胚的程式直接用在 100 mm 毛胚，溫差變成四倍，殘餘應力與雙折射也變成四倍，大塊毛胚切割時因應力釋放而翹曲甚至開裂。~Applying a 50 mm blank's schedule to a 100 mm blank quadruples the internal temperature difference and therefore the residual stress and birefringence, and the large blank warps or even cracks when cutting releases the stress.
units.misconception: 退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。~Annealing time depends only on the glass type, not on blank thickness.

units.anchor: 偏光儀與光彈常數~Polarimeter and photoelastic constant
units.title: 殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級~Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence
units.mechanism: 殘餘應力使玻璃成為弱雙折射材料，光程差與應力和光程長度成正比，比例係數是光彈常數 K。量測用偏光儀：Sénarmont 補償法把光程差轉成檢偏鏡的旋轉角，光彈調制器法則以交流訊號達到 0.1 nm 等級；結果以每公分光程的奈米數（nm/cm）表示，是玻璃型錄的分級量。因為毛胚內應力分佈為中心拉、表面壓，量測要在穿透厚度方向與多個位置進行，並以平均與最大值分別記錄。~Residual stress makes glass weakly birefringent, with an optical path difference proportional to stress and path length through the photoelastic constant K. It is measured with a polarimeter: the Sénarmont compensation method converts the path difference into an analyser rotation angle, and photoelastic-modulator methods reach the 0.1 nm level with an AC signal; the result is quoted in nanometres per centimetre of path (nm/cm), the grading quantity in glass catalogues. Because the stress is tensile at the centre and compressive at the surface, measurement is made through the thickness at several positions and reported as both mean and maximum.
units.model: N-BK7 的光彈常數 K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹，即每 MPa 應力產生 2.77×10⁻⁶ 的 Δn，換算為 27.7 nm/cm。前一單元 1 K/h 冷卻的 0.33 MPa 對應約 9.1 nm/cm，超過 4 nm/cm 的精密退火等級；0.3 K/h 的 0.10 MPa 對應 2.7 nm/cm，合格。反過來，量到 6 nm/cm 就表示約 0.22 MPa 的應力。~The photoelastic constant of N-BK7 is K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹, so each MPa of stress produces a Δn of 2.77×10⁻⁶, equivalent to 27.7 nm/cm. The 0.33 MPa from 1 K/h cooling in the previous unit corresponds to about 9.1 nm/cm, beyond a 4 nm/cm precision-annealed grade; the 0.10 MPa from 0.3 K/h gives 2.7 nm/cm and passes. Conversely, a reading of 6 nm/cm implies about 0.22 MPa of stress.
units.verify: 先用已知光程差的石英波片校正偏光儀的零點與線性，再對毛胚沿厚度方向在中心、半徑一半與邊緣各量數點，除以實際路徑長度得到 nm/cm；用熔融石英參考片確認背景讀值低於 0.5 nm/cm，並比較兩個正交方向的讀值以區分應力與材料本質雙折射。~Calibrate the polarimeter's zero and linearity with quartz waveplates of known retardation, then measure the blank through its thickness at the centre, half radius and edge and divide by the actual path length to obtain nm/cm; confirm with a fused-silica reference that the background reading is below 0.5 nm/cm, and compare two orthogonal orientations to separate stress from intrinsic material birefringence.
units.failure: 量測時以毛胚標稱厚度而非實際厚度換算 nm/cm，或量測點集中在應力為零的中性面附近，報告低估最大應力，鏡片在精磨減薄後因應力重新分佈而彎曲，面形失效。~Converting to nm/cm with the nominal instead of the actual thickness, or measuring only near the stress-free neutral plane, understates the maximum stress; the lens then bends when fine grinding thins it and redistributes the stress, and its figure fails.
units.misconception: 只要雙折射讀值為零，毛胚裡就沒有應力。~A zero birefringence reading means the blank contains no stress.

units.anchor: 折射儀與均勻性干涉量測~Refractometer and homogeneity interferometry
units.title: 折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度~Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty
units.mechanism: 折射率以 V 形塊折射儀（精度約 1×10⁻⁵）或光譜測角儀的最小偏向角法（可達數個 10⁻⁶）在多條譜線量測，Abbe 數由 n_d、n_F、n_C 算出；均勻性則用干涉儀量穿透波前：把毛胚磨成平行板後量透射波前，扣除兩個表面的面形貢獻（以油浸或分別量測表面的方法）後，剩餘波前除以厚度就是折射率的空間變化。這些量的不確定度要與公差等級一起寫進熔次資料表，因為設計端會依此決定是否需要重算。~Refractive index is measured on several spectral lines with a V-block refractometer (about 1×10⁻⁵) or by the minimum-deviation method on a spectral goniometer (a few 10⁻⁶), and the Abbe number follows from n_d, n_F and n_C; homogeneity is measured interferometrically on the transmitted wavefront: the blank is worked into a parallel plate, the transmitted wavefront is measured, the contributions of the two surfaces are removed by oil immersion or by separate surface measurements, and the remaining wavefront divided by thickness gives the spatial index variation. The uncertainties of these quantities must appear in the melt data sheet together with the tolerance grades, because the design side decides from them whether a recompute is needed.
units.model: 透射波前 W = Δn·L：厚度 L = 100 mm 的毛胚若扣除表面後波前 PV 為 50 nm，Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷，優於 H4 的 ±1×10⁻⁶；干涉儀 10 nm 的不確定度對應 1×10⁻⁷ 的折射率不確定度。折射率量測不確定度 1×10⁻⁵ 時，Abbe 數 ν_d = (n_d − 1)/(n_F − n_C) 的不確定度約 (n_F − n_C) 誤差 1.4×10⁻⁵ 除以 0.00806 乘以 64，約 ±0.11。~The transmitted wavefront is W = Δn·L: for a 100 mm thick blank with a surface-corrected wavefront PV of 50 nm, Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷, better than the ±1×10⁻⁶ of grade H4; an interferometer uncertainty of 10 nm corresponds to an index uncertainty of 1×10⁻⁷. With an index uncertainty of 1×10⁻⁵, the Abbe number ν_d = (n_d − 1)/(n_F − n_C) carries an uncertainty of roughly the (n_F − n_C) error 1.4×10⁻⁵ divided by 0.00806 times 64, about ±0.11.
units.verify: 以經校正的參考玻璃（已知 n_d 到 10⁻⁶）檢查折射儀的偏差，每天記錄；均勻性量測前後各量一次空腔，確認干涉儀參考面與環境漂移小於 5 nm；把兩次獨立安裝的均勻性圖相減，殘差 RMS 應小於宣稱不確定度。~Check the refractometer's bias daily with a calibrated reference glass of known n_d to 10⁻⁶; measure the empty cavity before and after each homogeneity measurement to confirm that reference-surface and environmental drift stay below 5 nm; subtract two homogeneity maps from independent mountings and confirm that the residual RMS is below the claimed uncertainty.
units.failure: 均勻性量測若未扣除毛胚表面的面形，表面 100 nm 的彎曲被當成體內折射率變化，報告錯判為 H2 級而被降價出售，或反過來把真正不均勻的毛胚判為合格而流入大口徑鏡頭。~If the blank's surface figure is not removed from the homogeneity measurement, 100 nm of surface curvature is read as bulk index variation and the blank is wrongly graded H2 and sold down, or conversely a truly inhomogeneous blank passes and ends up in a large-aperture lens.
units.misconception: 型錄上的折射率小數點後五位對每一塊毛胚都成立。~The five-decimal catalogue index holds for every individual blank.

units.anchor: 退火程式曲線與速率切換點~Annealing schedule curve and rate switch points
units.title: 退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合~Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated
units.mechanism: 完整的退火程式由四段組成：升溫到退火點附近並保溫足夠時間讓既有應力鬆弛與溫度均勻；以慢速率穿過退火點到應變點的轉變區，這一段決定折射率與永久應力；過了應變點後以較快速率冷卻，此時溫差只造成暫時的彈性應力，不再凍結，但仍須低於玻璃的破裂強度；最後接近室溫時再減速避免熱衝擊。速率切換點與各段速率都由前面的鬆弛時間、Adams–Williamson 應力與折射率公差共同決定。~A complete schedule has four segments: heating to near the annealing point and holding long enough for existing stress to relax and the temperature to equalise; cooling slowly through the transition range from annealing to strain point, the segment that fixes index and permanent stress; cooling faster below the strain point, where the temperature difference causes only transient elastic stress that no longer freezes but must stay below the fracture strength of the glass; and slowing again near room temperature to avoid thermal shock. The switch points and each segment's rate follow jointly from the relaxation times, the Adams–Williamson stress and the index tolerance derived earlier.
units.model: 100 mm N-BK7：保溫 2 h（約 250 個 29 s 的鬆弛時間常數）；以 0.3 K/h 從 560 °C 冷到 480 °C，80 K 需 267 h ≈ 11 天；再以 5 K/h 冷到 20 °C，460 K 需 92 h ≈ 3.8 天，此段暫時溫差 ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K，暫時應力 ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa，遠低於約 50 MPa 的設計強度；若改用 50 K/h，暫時應力達 17 MPa，對含表面缺陷的大毛胚已有破裂風險。全程約 15 天。~For 100 mm N-BK7: hold 2 h (about 250 relaxation constants of 29 s); cool at 0.3 K/h from 560 °C to 480 °C, 80 K in 267 h ≈ 11 days; then cool at 5 K/h to 20 °C, 460 K in 92 h ≈ 3.8 days, during which the transient difference ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K gives a transient stress ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa, far below a design strength of about 50 MPa; at 50 K/h the transient stress would reach 17 MPa, already a fracture risk for a large blank with surface flaws. The whole schedule takes about 15 days.
units.verify: 把程式輸入控制器後以空爐試跑並記錄實際溫度曲線，確認每段速率誤差小於 10%、切換點無過衝；正式批次完成後量折射率、雙折射與均勻性，與程式設計時的預測值（n_d 偏移、nm/cm）逐項比較，差異超過預算就回頭修正速率或保溫時間。~Load the schedule into the controller, run it with an empty furnace and record the actual curve to confirm that each segment's rate error is below 10% and the switch points show no overshoot; after the production batch, measure index, birefringence and homogeneity and compare each with the predictions made when the schedule was designed (n_d shift, nm/cm), revising rates or hold time when a difference exceeds budget.
units.failure: 為縮短週期把慢冷段從 0.3 提高到 1 K/h，殘餘應力升到 9 nm/cm、折射率比參考值低約 0.0005，整批毛胚從精密級降為標準級，省下的 8 天抵不過降級的損失。~Raising the slow-cool segment from 0.3 to 1 K/h to shorten the cycle lifts residual stress to 9 nm/cm and lowers the index by about 0.0005 relative to the reference, downgrading the whole batch from precision to standard grade, and the 8 days saved never repay the loss.
units.misconception: 退火程式越慢越好，速率沒有下限。~A slower annealing schedule is always better, with no lower limit on rate.

units.anchor: 熔次資料表與設計重算~Melt data sheet and design recompute
units.title: 熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接~Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 退火完成的毛胚以熔次資料表交付：實測的 n_d、ν_d 與各譜線折射率、折射率與 Abbe 數的公差等級、應力雙折射（nm/cm）、均勻性等級、條紋與氣泡等級，以及退火速率與量測不確定度。光學設計端拿到實測值後進行「熔次重算」：把設計中的型錄折射率換成實測值，重新最佳化曲率、厚度或空氣間隔，再把修正後的加工圖交給光學工廠。沒有這一步，精密退火得到的折射率精度就白費了。~An annealed blank is delivered with a melt data sheet: measured n_d, ν_d and indices at each spectral line, the tolerance grades for index and Abbe number, stress birefringence in nm/cm, homogeneity grade, striae and bubble classes, plus the annealing rate and measurement uncertainties. The optical designer then performs a melt recompute, replacing catalogue indices in the design with measured values and re-optimising radii, thicknesses or air spaces before releasing corrected fabrication drawings to the optics shop. Without this step the index accuracy won by precision annealing is simply wasted.
units.model: 薄透鏡焦距對折射率的靈敏度 Δf/f = −Δn/(n − 1)：熔次實測 n_d = 1.5171 而設計用 1.5168，Δn = +0.0003，f = 100 mm 時 Δf = −100×0.0003/0.5168 ≈ −58 µm。f/4 系統在 550 nm 的焦深約 ±2λ(f/#)² = ±2×0.55×16 ≈ ±18 µm，焦距偏移是焦深的 3 倍，必須重算或調整空氣間隔。~Thin-lens focal sensitivity to index is Δf/f = −Δn/(n − 1): with a melt value n_d = 1.5171 against a design value of 1.5168, Δn = +0.0003, and for f = 100 mm, Δf = −100×0.0003/0.5168 ≈ −58 µm. An f/4 system at 550 nm has a depth of focus of about ±2λ(f/#)² = ±2×0.55×16 ≈ ±18 µm, so the focal shift is 3 times the depth of focus and a recompute or air-space adjustment is mandatory.
units.verify: 核對資料表上每個數值都附有量測方法與不確定度，且熔次編號與毛胚標記一致；設計端用實測折射率重新追跡，確認重算後的像質回到名義值，並把更新的曲率與厚度以版本號記錄在加工圖與交接文件中。~Check that every value on the sheet carries its measurement method and uncertainty and that the melt number matches the blank marking; have the design side re-trace with the measured indices, confirm that the recomputed image quality returns to nominal, and record the updated radii and thicknesses with a version number on the fabrication drawings and in the handoff record.
units.failure: 兩個熔次的同牌號玻璃折射率相差 0.0004，若工廠混用而設計未按熔次重算，同一批鏡頭的焦距分佈變成雙峰，組裝時無法用統一的墊片補償，良率驟降。~Two melts of the same glass type differing by 0.0004 in index, mixed in the shop without a per-melt recompute, give the lens batch a bimodal focal-length distribution that no single shim can compensate at assembly, and yield collapses.
units.misconception: 同牌號的光學玻璃不論熔次，折射率都一樣。~Optical glass of the same type has the same index regardless of melt.

example: 退火程式練習：N-BK7 毛胚厚 100 mm，熱擴散率 a ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s，Eα/(1−ν) ≈ 0.73 MPa/K，光彈常數 27.7 nm/cm 每 MPa，目標雙折射 ≤ 4 nm/cm、折射率公差 ±0.0002。第一步：1 K/h 時 ΔT = q·d²/(8a) = 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(4.16×10⁻⁶) ≈ 0.67 K，永久應力 σ ≈ (2/3)×0.73×0.67 ≈ 0.33 MPa，雙折射 ≈ 9.1 nm/cm，不合格。第二步：改 0.3 K/h，ΔT ≈ 0.20 K，σ ≈ 0.10 MPa，雙折射 ≈ 2.7 nm/cm，合格。第三步：若玻璃廠的參考速率為 h₀ 且退火係數 m ≈ −0.001，0.3 K/h 相對 h₀ 的折射率偏移為 −0.001×log₁₀(0.3/h₀)；要落在 ±0.0002 內，0.3 K/h 必須在 0.63h₀ 到 1.6h₀ 之間，否則把偏移量寫進熔次資料表供設計重算。第四步：時間預算為保溫 2 h、慢冷 80 K/0.3 = 267 h、快冷 460 K/5 = 92 h，共約 15 天；快冷段暫時應力 ≈ 1.7 MPa，安全。最後以偏光儀與均勻性干涉驗收，並做熔次重算。數值皆為教學假設。~Annealing-schedule exercise: an N-BK7 blank 100 mm thick, diffusivity a ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s, Eα/(1−ν) ≈ 0.73 MPa/K, photoelastic constant 27.7 nm/cm per MPa, target birefringence ≤ 4 nm/cm and index tolerance ±0.0002. Step one: at 1 K/h, ΔT = q·d²/(8a) = 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(4.16×10⁻⁶) ≈ 0.67 K, permanent stress σ ≈ (2/3)×0.73×0.67 ≈ 0.33 MPa, birefringence ≈ 9.1 nm/cm, a failure. Step two: at 0.3 K/h, ΔT ≈ 0.20 K, σ ≈ 0.10 MPa, birefringence ≈ 2.7 nm/cm, a pass. Step three: if the maker's reference rate is h₀ and the annealing coefficient m ≈ −0.001, the index shift of 0.3 K/h relative to h₀ is −0.001×log₁₀(0.3/h₀); to stay within ±0.0002, 0.3 K/h must lie between 0.63h₀ and 1.6h₀, otherwise the shift is written into the melt data sheet for the design recompute. Step four: the time budget is 2 h hold, slow cool 80 K/0.3 = 267 h, fast cool 460 K/5 = 92 h, about 15 days in all; the transient stress in the fast segment is ≈ 1.7 MPa, which is safe. Finally accept with the polarimeter and homogeneity interferometry and perform the melt recompute. All numbers are teaching assumptions.
history: 夫朗和斐在 19 世紀初就發現條紋與應力限制了光學玻璃的品質；1884 年奧托·肖特與阿貝、蔡司在耶拿建立系統化的光學玻璃研發，退火成為固定工序；1920 年 Adams 與 Williamson 以黏彈性理論量化退火中的應力鬆弛與永久應力，1946 年 Tool 提出假想溫度概念解釋折射率與熱歷史的關係；之後 SCHOTT、Ohara 與 HOYA 以電腦控制的精密退火爐與分級制度（折射率公差、均勻性、雙折射等級）支撐微影與天文光學對大口徑毛胚的要求。本課只整理公開的物理與工程方法。~Fraunhofer recognised in the early 19th century that striae and stress limited optical-glass quality; in 1884 Otto Schott with Abbe and Zeiss established systematic optical-glass development in Jena with annealing as a fixed process step; in 1920 Adams and Williamson quantified stress relaxation and permanent stress in annealing with viscoelastic theory, and in 1946 Tool introduced the fictive-temperature concept linking refractive index to thermal history; SCHOTT, Ohara and HOYA later used computer-controlled precision annealing furnaces and grading systems (index tolerance, homogeneity and birefringence grades) to meet the large-blank demands of lithography and astronomical optics. This course compiles only public physics and engineering methods.
